clue.text: Stole tiny amount to get to sporting event

parts.note: a boa is a long scarf or stole of feathers or fur
a trace is a barely detectable quantity

explanation.surface: A thief pockets a tiny sum to pay their way into a sporting fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stole' looks like the past tense of steal, but it is the wrap worn over the shoulders. The Boat Race is the annual Oxford v Cambridge rowing contest on the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: The Boat Race is a famous annual rowing contest, an example of a sporting fixture.

indicators.note: without a heart means the central letter of the word for weapon is removed

parts.note: a spear is a thrown or thrust weapon

explanation.surface: Someone joins a fight armed, but without much spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: To spar is to box or argue, a verb synonym for fighting.

indicators.note: 'from' says the letters are taken straight out of the following words of the clue

parts.note: the letters run across the end of the first word, the 'a', and the start of the last

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a horrible youth detention centre as a dreadful jail.
explanation.walkthrough: A borstal was a British reform institution for young offenders, which makes the surface plausible.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalag was a German prisoner-of-war camp in the Second World War, so a kind of prison.

clue.text: Hear about old and sad story

indicators.note: 'about' means the word for hear goes around the word for old

parts.note: a judge hears or tries a case
aged means old

explanation.surface: Listen to an old, melancholy tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hear' looks like listening; here it is the court sense, to try a case.
explanation.definitionFit: A tragedy is a drama or tale with an unhappy ending, so a sad story.

clue.text: Is inclined to follow pen designers

indicators.note: 'to follow' places the words for is inclined after the word for pen

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs
a ship lists when it leans to one side

explanation.surface: Someone leans towards fountain-pen designers.
explanation.definitionFit: Stylists design hairstyles or fashion looks, so they are designers of a kind.

clue.text: Landlord home contents in B&B that might blow up

definitions.note: a descriptive clause standing for the noun

parts.note: a landlord lets property, so is one who lets

indicators.note: 'in' places the kept letters inside the two letters of B&B

parts.note: the two Bs taken as written

indicators.note: the contents of a word are its inside letters, without the outer ones

parts.note: the inside letters of home

explanation.surface: A landlord's possessions inside a bed and breakfast might explode.
explanation.walkthrough: B&B is bed and breakfast, a British guest house; here it just supplies two Bs.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter bomb is an explosive device sent through the post, something that might blow up.

clue.text: They say soft cheeses give you wind

indicators.note: 'they say' means the word is what people pronounce, not what is spelt

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese

explanation.surface: A folk warning that eating soft cheese causes flatulence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wind' in the surface means flatulence; the answer is a gentle wind.
explanation.definitionFit: A breeze is a light wind blowing outdoors.

indicators.note: the start of incomer's is read as a separate word saying one piece goes inside another

parts.note: read as 'in comer's': a comer is one who comes, and the leading 'in' is the insertion signal
to put is to place or install

explanation.surface: Setting up the new arrival's computer kit.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's single word for a newcomer has to be split in two, its first syllable becoming the instruction to insert.
explanation.definitionFit: A computer is the central piece of information technology hardware.

clue.text: Finally grant beneficiaries what belongs to them

indicators.note: 'finally' points to the end letter of the next word

parts.note: the last letter of grant
heirs are those who benefit from a will

explanation.surface: At last the will's beneficiaries are given their share.
explanation.definitionFit: The possessive pronoun theirs means the thing owned by those people.

parts.note: a star is a famous person
toff is British slang for an upper-class person

explanation.surface: Open proceedings in the company of a celebrated nobleman.
explanation.walkthrough: The enumeration (5,3) moves the word break one letter along from where the wordplay's two pieces meet.
explanation.definitionFit: To start off is a phrasal verb meaning to commence.

clue.text: Garlanded girl secures points of law

indicators.note: something garlanded has a wreath placed around it, so one piece is wrapped by another

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian flower garland
gal is informal for girl
ties means fastens or secures

explanation.surface: A girl wearing flowers clinches the legal arguments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Garlanded' does double duty: it supplies the garland and says the girl is inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Legalities are the formal requirements or technical details of the law.

parts.note: surface reading: a medical condition about food, perhaps caught from a Moroccan stew
setter's reading: the first word of the answer, once its letters are muddled, comes from the word tagine, a food

explanation.surface: A digestive complaint that came from eating a tagine.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse anagram: the answer reads as an instruction to muddle its first word, and doing so yields tagine, a slow-cooked North African stew.
explanation.definitionFit: Anorexia and bulimia are eating disorders, conditions that make food and eating a problem.

parts.note: I do is the vow made at a wedding

indicators.note: radical change is thoroughgoing, so these letters are rearranged completely

parts.note: so plus the first five letters of the long word; its tail is the anagram signal

explanation.surface: A heathen promise that is extremely revolutionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultraradical' must be split into the fodder's end and the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Idolatrous means worshipping idols, which is how monotheists characterise pagan religion.

clue.text: Takes up arms and starts to repel enemy units

indicators.note: 'starts to' means the opening letter of each of the next two words is used

parts.note: the first letters of repel and enemy
the volt is the unit of electric potential

explanation.surface: An army mobilises and begins to drive back hostile units.
explanation.definitionFit: To revolt is to rebel, often by armed uprising, so it means taking up arms.

parts.note: a trip is a short holiday
lets are rented properties

explanation.surface: Holiday cottages advertised for a group of three.
explanation.definitionFit: Triplets are three babies born together, a set of three.

indicators.note: fifty per cent means half of the following word is kept

parts.note: the second half of refund

explanation.surface: Shock at being given only half the money back.
explanation.definitionFit: To astound is to amaze, a stronger synonym for surprise.

parts.note: to nail is to fix in place
a file is a dossier of documents

explanation.surface: Repairing a dossier that improves digital technology.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digital' sounds computing-related but refers to the fingers, the digits.
explanation.definitionFit: A nail file smooths fingernails, improving the look of one's digits.

clue.text: I'm gay, so in need of modification for reproductive method

indicators.note: needing modification means the letters must be altered into a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged, ignoring punctuation

explanation.surface: Someone says their sexuality needs a different route to having children.
explanation.definitionFit: Isogamy is sexual reproduction by fusion of two gametes of the same size and form.

clue.text: Sign in private at their office?

definitions.text: Sign in private at their office?

indicators.note: 'in' places the zodiac sign inside the word for private

parts.note: private means not public; the sign goes after the first word
Aries the ram is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Clients sign documents privately at the officials' premises.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes what happens with these officials, though 'at their office' adds to the picture rather than the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Notaries public are officials who witness and certify signatures on documents at their offices.

clue.text: Aphrodisiac supposedly taken by schoolboys? Terrific!

indicators.note: 'taken by' says the letters are held by the following words of the clue

parts.note: the letters span the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A schoolboy's excited reaction to hearing of a supposed love drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Oysters are traditionally reputed to arouse desire, so they are a supposed aphrodisiac.

parts.note: Peru is a South American nation

explanation.surface: A country's news has been listened to and read.
explanation.definitionFit: To peruse is to read through something carefully.

clue.text: Go back with hesitation after a short walk for one into stars

indicators.note: 'after' places the reversed word and hesitation behind the short walk
'short' means the word for walk loses its last letter

parts.note: taken as written
a stroll is a leisurely walk

indicators.note: 'back' says the word go is turned the other way round

parts.note: taken as written
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: A stargazer turns back, hesitating after a brief stroll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one into stars' is someone keen on them, as a horoscope reader is, not an astronomer.
explanation.definitionFit: An astrologer studies the stars and planets to make predictions, someone devoted to them.

indicators.note: 'extremely' means only the end letters of each of the next words are kept

parts.note: the outer letters of thrifty
the outer letters of penny-wise

explanation.surface: Someone frugal and careful with money is a particular kind of person.
explanation.walkthrough: The words look as if they hide something, but only their outer letters count.
explanation.definitionFit: A type is a sort or kind of thing or person.

indicators.note: something troubled is disturbed, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Northern Ireland suffering unrest as an aftermath.
explanation.walkthrough: Ulster is Northern Ireland, scene of the Troubles, which makes 'troubled' a neat surface word.
explanation.definitionFit: A result is an outcome, what follows from a cause, so a consequence.

parts.note: miss is a title for a young woman
